POWER_SECTION_DOC: Case power button and power-off signal. A double tap reboots the system or restarts the Volumio app (your choice below); press and hold (about 3 seconds) shuts down. Note: the case itself acts on a long press, with or without this plugin. Pressing and holding for 3 seconds or more switches the power off after a timeout (about 15 seconds). Holding for more than 5 seconds may cut the power immediately, but this behavior may not be implemented in every case firmware; the case's timeout still applies.
POWER_ENABLED_DOC: Handle the case power button. When off, Volumio ignores the button, but the case still powers itself off after a long press (see the note above).
POWER_DOUBLE_TAP_DOC: What a double tap on the case button does. Reboot the system: restarts the Pi. Restart the Volumio app only: restarts just the Volumio app (like the command volumio vrestart), which is quicker; the Pi stays up, and the case is not involved.
POWER_LOG_ONLY_DOC: Show a notification with the pulse width for every button press, but do not reboot, restart or shut down. Use this to check that presses are detected. Every pulse is also written to the Volumio log.
UART_SIGNAL_DOC: Tells the case when Volumio has finished shutting down, so the case can switch off immediately. This switch does two things. It enables the Pi serial port (UART) in the boot configuration. It also makes the plugin arm the case when a shutdown is started through Volumio, so the case waits for the UART signal or its own timeout (about 15 seconds). On: after a shutdown started from Volumio, the case switches off as soon as the system has finished shutting down (typically a few seconds). Off: a shutdown started with the power button switches the case off about 15 seconds after the button press, and a shutdown started from the Volumio interface leaves the case powered on until you long press its button or unplug it. Changing this needs a reboot. A shutdown started over SSH (shutdown, poweroff) bypasses Volumio, so the plugin does not arm the case: the UART still signals, but the case ignores it.
FAN_SECTION_DOC: Sets the case fan from the CPU temperature, using the same method as Argon's stock script: the temperature is read every 30 seconds, and the fan is switched off or slowed down only after the temperature has been lower for a further 30 seconds.
FAN_MODE_DOC: Off: the fan is switched off and the plugin no longer controls it. On/off (default): the fan is switched on at one temperature and off when the CPU is cooler. Speed steps: three temperature and speed setpoints. Speed steps may not be supported by the case: on some units (such as the V2) any speed above 0 runs the fan at full speed. Use speed steps only if the fan can actually change speed.
FAN_ON_TEMP_DOC: This is the setpoint: the fan is on at or above this CPU temperature and off below it.
FAN_TEMP_DOC: The fan uses the speed of the highest setpoint the CPU temperature has reached, and is off below setpoint 1. Temperatures must rise and speeds must not fall from setpoint 1 to 3.
FAN_SPEED_DOC: 0 turns the fan off. Speeds from 1 to 24 are raised to 25.
SHOW_TEMP_DOC: Reads the CPU temperature and shows it in a popup, with the fan state and mode. Does not change the fan.
FAN_ERR_RANGE: %s must be a whole number from %s to %s
FAN_ERR_ORDER: Temperatures must rise and speeds must not fall from setpoint 1 to 3
UART_ST_BLOCKED: Cannot be enabled (blocked by another setting, see the Volumio log)
UART_CONFLICT: Cannot enable the UART: a boot setting turns it off (%s). Remove that line and try again
UART_MALFORMED: Nothing was changed: the plugin's block in /boot/userconfig.txt is incomplete (a BEGIN or END line argon_one_power_fan is missing or doubled). Fix or remove it by hand and try again
UART_FOREIGN_KEPT: The UART is already enabled by another setting (%s); nothing was written
UART_REMOVED_FOREIGN: The plugin's UART setting was removed. The UART stays enabled by another setting (%s)
REBOOT_MESSAGE: The UART setting takes effect after a reboot. Reboot now?
BUTTON_RESTART: Case button: restarting the Volumio app
BUTTON_TEST_REBOOT: Case button: double tap detected, pulse %s ms (test mode, no action)
BUTTON_TEST_SHUTDOWN: Case button: hold detected, pulse %s ms (test mode, no action)
BUTTON_START_FAILED: Cannot start watching the power button: %s
TEMP_TOAST_FAN_OFF: CPU temperature %s °C. Fan control is off
